name: Ovoid Pillow with Decoration of Blossoming Lotus Plants
summary: This unusually large, bean-shaped pillow, or headrest, has a flat bottom, slightly convex sides, and a wide, concave top. Three white lotus blossoms surrounded by green lily pads and arrow-shaped leaves emblazon the top, the scene set against a a well-articulated background of bright yellow scrolling foliage in shallow relief on a reddish brown ground.
